in_arabic.name: خليلون
in_arabic.meaning: أحمد، صديق، من أهل الخير، وذو حب من الله، من الصديقين
in_arabic.long_meaning: أحمد هو الاسم الأول من الخليلون، وهو واحد من أسماء الله الحسنى، يطلق على الصديقين، أولهم خالد بن الوليد، والثاني سيدنا عمر بن الخطاب، ويستخدم أيضًا للإشارة إلى الأشخاص الذين يتمتعون بتجليدهم من الله. يُعتبر الخليلون جزءًا من أصل عربي يعود إلى جذور كلمتي "خَليل" ومعناها "صديق" أو "أحمد"، وتستمر استخدام هذه الأسماء في الإسلام لتمثيل القيمة الدينية وتعزيز العلاقة بين الإنسان والله.

in_urdu.name: خلیلوں
in_urdu.meaning: احمد، صدیق، اچھے لوگ، اللہ کے چاہنے والوں، مسلمانوں میں سے
in_urdu.long_meaning: احمد کہنا پہلے نام ہیں خلیلوں کے، یہ اللہ کے بہترین ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، اور یہ ایک دوسرے کے لیے بھی استعمال ہوتا ہے جہاں دونوں ایسے ہوتے ہیں جیسے اللہ کی طرف سے محبّت والے، جیسا کہ کہا جاتا ہے کہ ان کے لیے اللہ کے ساتھ بہت زیادہ محبّت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: खलीलुन्
in_hindi.meaning: अहमद, सच्चे, अच्छे, दयालु, भगवान के प्रेमी
in_hindi.long_meaning: अहमद खलीलुन का पहला नाम है, यह अरबी में एक अच्छा नाम है, जिसका अर्थ है अच्छा, सच्चा, दयालु और भगवान के प्रेमी। यह नाम सीरत-ए-मस्तिसाबी के मुताबिक़ खलीलुन के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है, जो एक अच्छे मुसलमान के लिए एक आदर्श नाम है।

in_pashto.meaning: احمد، صدیق، اچھے لوگ، دایړ، الله کے چاہنے والوں

in_english.name: Khalilun
in_english.meaning: Ahmed, friend, good, loving, beloved of Allah, devout Muslims
in_english.long_meaning: Khalilun is a name that originates from the Arabic root "Khaleel" meaning "friend" or "Ahmed", one of the most beautiful names of Allah, used to describe the righteous and devoted believers who are close to Allah. In Islamic tradition, the name Khalilun is associated with the Arabic root "Khaleel" and is used to describe individuals who are loved and cherished by Allah, and who embody the qualities of compassion, kindness, and devotion.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Khalilun" in Arabic culture denotes a person who is trustworthy, reliable, and faithful. This name was often given to children who were cherished and held in high regard, as their character reflected qualities that were valuable to their community. In Islamic history, there is a notable character named Khalil Ibn Saba, who rose to power as a vizier in Egypt during the Fatimid dynasty. His exceptional intellect and morality earned him great respect and trust from the caliphs, consolidating his authority and leaving a lasting impact on Egyptian politics.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Khalilun" can be traced back to its roots in the Hebrew Bible, where it signifies "friend of God." In Islamic tradition, the name is given to those who embody the concept of being a friend to Allah. It is a reminder that every person strives to develop a personal relationship with the Creator and seeks His love and guidance. Additionally, the bond between a true friend and another is so deep that they both share a mutual respect, trust, and love, ultimately reflecting the divine love in the relationship between Allah and his creation.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Friend of Allah" symbolizes Trustworthy, Faithful, Friend. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Khalilun serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of friend of allah.
